purpose: Propuestas visuales; todavía no sustituyen el escenario jugable.

variants.name: Modelo 1 · Madera y ámbar
variants.prompt:
Create one premium, detailed PIXEL ART concept image for the existing educational game Engranajes del Cambio, British coal mine in the Industrial Revolution. Landscape 16:9. This is a redesigned SIDE-SCROLLING tunnel, strict side elevation, shallow depth, NOT an enormous cavern, NOT isometric, NOT a room seen from above, NOT a tunnel receding into the distance.
Scale is the overriding requirement: show one clearly visible chibi protagonist wearing a golden straw hat, white shirt, brown waistcoat, brown trousers and boots, with a large head, dark hair and bright dark eyes. His full body is around one fifth of the frame height. The tunnel ceiling is only 2.3 protagonist-heights above the walking floor. All beams, lamps, props and the elevator must be sized for this small character. Preserve a clean single horizontal walkable floor across the image, no jump platforms, no branching passages, no vertical movement outside the lift.
At the FAR LEFT beginning of the tunnel, put a compact open-front wooden-and-iron mine lift cage, approximately 1.8 character heights tall, just wide enough for 1 or 2 people, with a floor flush with the tunnel floor and ropes going upward in a narrow shaft. Show clearly that the character can step into the cage from the right. No elevator on the right.
Across the corridor show THREE separated minor roof-fall areas: one has sparse pebbles already falling, one only a thin dust warning, the last is quiet with a few loose stones at the foot of the wall. Falling stones are irregular grey or coal-dark angular rocks roughly 1/15 to 1/6 of the character's height, hand-sized to head-sized, NEVER human-sized boulders. The protagonist is standing safely before the active fall, waiting, unobscured. Most of the route stays unobstructed. At far right a modest exposed coal seam and a small collection crate provide the mining destination.
Composition: the tunnel opening dominates the central horizontal band, dark cutaway earth above and below frames it; close enough camera to read the hero and human-scale lift. Crisp visible pixel clusters, exquisite wood/stone material art, clear silhouettes, controlled lighting, handcrafted professional game art. No text, no labels, no arrows, no HUD, no menus, no watermark, no other characters. This is a proposal preview with the protagonist included for SCALE ONLY, not a final background asset.
MODEL 1: traditional intimate timber-supported drift. Weathered honey-brown oak square posts and short crossbeams, dark charcoal coal wall, warm amber oil lamps at human reach, compact wooden elevator with iron straps and a small brass bell beside its opening. Flat earthen floor with narrow low cart rails which do not obstruct walking. Cozy but convincing underground mood, exceptional wood pixel texture, reference-friendly readable small scale. Four short bays, subtle amber light pools, earthy palette.

More grounded sober working mine, distinctive crafted brick detail, no grand cathedral arches.
